vanilla.chapter.prologue.title: Prologue
vanilla.dialogue.prologue.trader.node.ha: Hey, traveller! Hold on. You don't meet a living soul out here often.
vanilla.dialogue.prologue.trader.node.ne: I've come from over there. There's a village close by, and things are bad: raiders come for them at night.
Someone ought to help them. Only you, I see, have nothing in your hands.
vanilla.dialogue.prologue.trader.node.of: Here's the thing. I have leather armour and a few tools: a pickaxe, a sword, an axe. I won't take money. We'll settle later — with a favour.
vanilla.dialogue.prologue.trader.node.ch: I'll manage. I don't like owing anyone.
vanilla.dialogue.prologue.trader.node.to: Good. I won't forget. Don't you forget either.
vanilla.dialogue.prologue.trader.node.ad: You have a sword — that's good. The elder listens to people like that.
Remember one thing: don't go to the elder without a sword. A wooden one will do, as long as it's yours. Otherwise he'll think you came to gawk.
Armour wouldn't hurt either, even leather. The raiders shoot crossbows.
vanilla.dialogue.prologue.trader.node.fa: The village is that way, not far. Good luck, traveller. We'll meet again.
vanilla.quest.prologue.night_guests.text: A wandering trader told of a village nearby: raiders attack it at night, and it needs help.
The village lived through the night. In the morning the elder told of the people who went looking for an ancient stronghold and never came back.
vanilla.quest.prologue.night_guests.stag: The trader says the village is somewhere near.
The village is here. Help is a matter for the elder.
The elder won't take help from someone without a sword.
The elder agreed. The raiders come at night.
Wait for night in the village
Night must find you near the elder.
Dark has fallen. The raiders are here.
The night is over. The elder is waiting.
vanilla.waypoint.prologue.village.name: Village
vanilla.waypoint.prologue.elder.name: Elder
vanilla.dialogue.prologue.elder.node.str: Who are you? Not from around here.
vanilla.dialogue.prologue.elder.node.off: The trader said you need help.
vanilla.dialogue.prologue.elder.node.tra: The trader... Well, he told the truth. We do.
vanilla.dialogue.prologue.elder.node.una: Bare-handed, you're no help to us. Find yourself a sword — even a wooden one — then come back.
vanilla.dialogue.prologue.elder.node.pra: And dressed for it, too. Not your first time, I see.
vanilla.dialogue.prologue.elder.node.tas: They come at night, two or three of them. I'm not asking you to kill them all. Hold out until morning.
vanilla.dialogue.prologue.elder.node.wai: Be in the village at night. They'll come.
Hold on! It's not long until morning.
vanilla.dialogue.prologue.elder.node.tha: We made it. Thank you, traveller.
vanilla.dialogue.prologue.elder.node.use: There was a time we had people of our own to stand for the village.
vanilla.dialogue.prologue.elder.node.exp: A few of ours went looking for a stronghold. An ancient one, under the ground. They say it was built long before us.
vanilla.dialogue.prologue.elder.node.nev: They left and never came back. It's been a long time.
vanilla.dialogue.prologue.elder.node.rum: Who knows. Some say for riches. Others, that the answer to where we all came from is down there. I don't believe either.
vanilla.dialogue.prologue.elder.node.ask: If you ever find a trace of them... tell me.
vanilla.dialogue.prologue.elder.node.idl: Quiet for now. And thanks for that.
